subject: Post-call: technical QA and integration playbook for reranker rollout
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Healy <tim.healy@searchlytics.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@searchlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T23:05:00Z
Subject: Post-call: technical QA and integration playbook for reranker rollout

Hi Tim and Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo this afternoon — great conversation. Two quick follow-ups from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

1) Clarify architecture needs: you mentioned using our hosted API for ranking but running embeddings on-prem. Can you confirm whether the embedding pipeline will be able to send anonymized vectors to Redwood, or if you need a private deployment (VPC/on-prem)?
2) SDK & auth: we recommend our Node + Python SDKs with service-account based JWTs for server-to-server traffic. Any constraints on key rotation or KMS?
3) Evaluation plan: we'll provide a small harness to run a rerank A/B on a sample corpus. Please share any relevance labels (CSV) and a target top_k you care about.

Proposed next steps:
- You share the sample corpus + labels (we suggest 1k queries) — Marcus to send
- We schedule a 90-minute technical workshop next week (deep dive: SDK, auth, routing, structured outputs)
- Redwood runs a 2-day eval and shares baseline metrics (MRR, NDCG@5, precision@k)

Attachments: sample evaluation template and an architecture sketch are attached for reference.

Best,

Aisha
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Tim Healy <tim.healy@searchlytics.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@searchlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T23:48:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: technical QA and integration playbook for reranker rollout

Thanks Aisha — this is perfect. Quick clarifications from our infra team (Marcus here):

- We cannot send raw PII. The embedding pipeline can export tokenized/anonymized vectors or we can host the embedding step in our VPC. Prefer to avoid sending text off-prem.
- We use GCP KMS for keys; rotation every 90 days is required.
- For evaluation, we can provide a 1k query set with relevance labels (CSV). Our product team is focused on precision@3 and NDCG@5.

I've attached our high-level infra diagram and a sample piece of the labeled CSV. Marcus will follow up with the full dataset.

Thanks,

Tim
Head of Search
Searchlytics

[Attachment: sample-relevances.csv (text/csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T00:15:00Z
Subject: RE: Post-call: technical QA and integration playbook for reranker rollout

Aisha / Ben — notes and quick plan from our side for the workshop and eval.

Key integration points to cover in the workshop:
- SDK setup (Python/Node): how to stream queries, batch calls to ranking API, and handle streaming responses for top_k reordering.
- Auth: service-account JWT flow + GCP KMS integration; include a short demo of key rotation using our SDK.
- Routing & fallbacks: model routing policy (latency vs cost), automatic fallback to a smaller quantized model if throughput spikes.
- Structured output/tool-calling: show how to return explicit fields (score, explanation, rationale) and how to integrate with downstream toolchains for reranking signals.
- Embeddings + privacy options: discuss prefix-only anonymized vectors vs private embedding runner in a VPC.

Eval plan items:
- Baseline run: run their sample CSV through our hosted ranking API with top_k=5 and top_k=3; compute MRR, NDCG@3/5, precision@1/3.
- Slice analysis: measure performance by query intent buckets (navigational/transactional/informational).
- A/B: compare current production ranker -> Redwood reranker for 2k heldout queries.

Action items:
- Ben: can you prepare a short repo with sample-config.yaml (auth, endpoint, batch size) and a small script to compute MRR/NDCG? Target EOD tomorrow.
- Aisha: please coordinate the workshop slot and request the dataset from Marcus.

Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T01:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Post-call: technical QA and integration playbook for reranker rollout

Marissa — will do. Notes on the SDK/auth pieces and config I'm preparing:

- SDK: provide both sync and async examples. Default batching policy = 64 requests / 50ms window; configurable via client.batch_policy.*
- Auth: service account JWT, signed with a KMS key. We'll document key rotation: rotate key in KMS, update service account binding in <48h with zero-downtime.
- Routing: example policy file to route queries with threshold latency <150ms to low-latency pool; else route to cost-optimized pool with quantized model.
- Top_k tuning: API accepts top_k param and a rerank window size. Recommend starting with top_k=5; we'll compute precision@3 and NDCG@5. Also include script to sweep top_k in [1,3,5,10] and produce CSV of metrics.

I'm attaching sample-config.yaml and a quick script stub. Can also spin up a small dedicated test pool if they want isolated throughput.

Ben
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample-config.yaml (text/yaml)]
